placements.why: This envelope's content is entirely about a technical infrastructure decision (a database migration) — nothing in the supplied strata (which is empty) covers organizational-technical decisions of this kind, and future envelopes about architecture-grain choices will need a home. Minting the bare top-level category rather than a narrower one keeps it foundational, matching the pattern of Opportunity/Strategy/Product/etc. named in the instructions.
placements.title: Technical infrastructure decisions form their own organizational category
placements.frame: What architecture-level technical decisions (databases, platforms, systems) does the organization make, and what justifies them?

placements.title: The analytics database layer is committed to replacement, not proposed for one
placements.frame: Which infrastructure migration statements are performed as settled, ratified decisions — with what target system and what landing date?
placements.why: src-1's 'We're switching' and src-3's arrow-notation both perform the PostgreSQL→QuantumDB move as already decided rather than argued for, and src-5's Q3 2026 date extends that ratifying register into a concrete landing point. This is a recurring thematic subject (how infrastructure migrations get ratified and dated) that future envelopes will keep feeding, not a one-time fact — distinct from the benefit-claims that justify the decision, so it earns its own leaf under the newly minted Architecture strata.

placements.title: Quantified performance and cost gains are the standing case for infrastructure swaps
placements.frame: What quantified performance or cost benefits are cited to justify this and future infrastructure/architecture decisions?
placements.why: src-2's '10x query performance, lower licensing cost' and src-4's '10x analytical queries' restate the same performance claim first in prose then in labeled form, both offered as evidence/justification rather than as the decision itself. This is a recurring theme — quantified benefit claims accumulating as the rational case for architecture changes — not a single fact, so it merits its own leaf distinct from the ratification leaf, nested under the same Architecture strata.
